purpose: Synthetic defect/control pairs for checking failure-space discrimination without a fixed risk roster.

cases.normal_observation: action X succeeds in state A
cases.hidden_defect: the next operation fails after the same instance reaches state B
cases.minimum_discriminator: A -> X -> B -> next operation on the same instance

cases.normal_observation: the producer completes beyond the retained threshold
cases.minimum_discriminator: pause -> cross threshold -> resume -> next read or explicit gap

cases.normal_observation: visible recovery and hidden transport liveness pass
cases.hidden_defect: hiding before READY freezes a paint-dependent barrier
cases.minimum_discriminator: start -> hide before READY -> resume -> application progress

cases.normal_observation: socket, process and Pong remain present
cases.hidden_defect: the application parser and input owner make no progress
cases.minimum_discriminator: transport readback plus independent application-progress readback

cases.normal_observation: exit and separately fresh sessions each work
cases.hidden_defect: the exited flag survives exited -> fresh on one instance
cases.minimum_discriminator: exit -> start new -> READY -> first input on the same instance

cases.hidden_defect: a delayed callback reads a parent released before settlement
cases.minimum_discriminator: request close -> release attempt -> delayed callback -> single final free

cases.hidden_defect: a bound Thesis recovery obligation has no Scope observation owner
cases.minimum_discriminator: compare applicable Thesis obligations with Scope Acceptance

cases.normal_observation: canonical inspection decides the complete contract
cases.hidden_defect: none; lifecycle and concurrency are absent
cases.minimum_discriminator: direct canonical inspection without invented runtime dimensions

cases.normal_observation: source suggests a scheduler-sensitive path but runtime is unavailable
cases.minimum_discriminator: preserve the evidence limit instead of inferring pass or product failure
